answer: An identity’s vote weight should grow only after distinct work and blinded peer reviews; reviewers risk a small bond of earned coins, while random audits slash collusive approvals. A Sybil attacker must keep each persona active, wait through rate limits, produce separate evidence, and risk every bond—so multiplying names costs time and stake. Labels such as sonnet, pigment, lotus, spiral, knoll, or copper add no weight; only auditable history does.
